# Cap — Style Reference

> Frosted glass laid over a morning sky, one cobalt cursor. Regular-weight grotesk headlines, a light serif reading voice, a cool fog canvas, hairline rings instead of borders, and one cobalt blue kept for links and modes.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Cap speaks a sky-glass editorial-utility language. A #f2f2f2 fog canvas holds #ffffff paper panels, and #ffffff66 frosted-glass chips float on top. #1c1d21 onyx is the single inverted surface, used for the Sign Up button and the announcement pill. The chromatic budget is two hues, each assigned to one product mode: #2563eb cobalt for Instant Mode, links and active states, and an estimated #7c3aed iris for Studio Mode. Saturated color is allowed only as linked phrases, mode badges and the hero CTA glow. Everything else inside the macOS mockups is mockup-internal. The typography thesis is a split voice. Headlines are Instrument Sans at weight 400 with −0.03em tracking from 48 to 60px. Reading copy shifts into Source Serif 4 at weight 300, and one italic serif phrase swerves through the H1. Size carries hierarchy and weight does not. Pills at 9999px and 10–12px rounded rectangles sit on 1px rgba(17,17,17,0.05) rings rather than drop shadows. The page reads as an essay about a utility rather than a software spec sheet.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fog Canvas | `#f2f2f2` | `--color-fog-canvas` | Body background, the gutter around the hero panel and the strip behind feature sections — a cool neutral gray that makes #ffffff panels lift without any shadow. |
| Paper White | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-white` | Secondary button fill, demo stage cards, mockup windows and the Login button (68 uses) — the elevated surface of the system, made distinct by tone rather than depth. |
| Frosted Glass | `#ffffff66` | `--color-frosted-glass` | Mode switcher track, tab strips and chips over the sky illustration (84 uses, the most frequent background) — translucency lets the hero sky bleed through. Do not use it on flat fog where it turns muddy. |
| Onyx Ink | `#1c1d21` | `--color-onyx-ink` | Sign Up button, the "New" announcement pill and the floating chat button, plus 89 text uses — the only inverted surface, rationed so dark fills mark exactly one commitment per view. |
| Jet Ink | `#111111` | `--color-jet-ink` | Every H1, H2 and H3, feature lead-ins and mockup titles (89 uses) — a near-black that avoids the vibration of pure #000000 against fog. |
| Ink Caption | `#111111a3` | `--color-ink-caption` | Hero and section serif paragraphs, inactive mode pills and feature descriptions (79 uses) — an alpha of Jet Ink, so secondary text stays tonally related on any surface. |
| Iron Text | `#6b7079` | `--color-iron-text` | Supporting UI labels, mockup sidebars and secondary metadata (57 uses) — a cooler solid gray for places where alpha would stack over imagery. |
| Slate Caption | `#8a8f98` | `--color-slate-caption` | Timestamps, "Also available on" lines and tertiary mockup chrome (66 uses) — the quietest readable text. Do not use it for body copy longer than one line. |
| Steel Border | `#d3dce6` | `--color-steel-border` | The 1px border on the "See how Cap works" secondary button and outlined controls — a blue-tinted gray that ties outlines to the sky palette instead of to neutral gray. |

| Signal Cobalt | `#2563eb` | `--color-signal-cobalt` | Instant Mode linked phrases, the Instant Mode badge icon and active mockup buttons such as "Send invoice" — the one blue that means "Instant/share". Do not promote it to a large solid-fill CTA. |
| Frost Blue | `#e1effe` | `--color-frost-blue` | Primary download button fill, active mode-pill background and feature icon tiles (12 uses) — a pale tint that carries the accent as glass rather than paint. |
| Iris Studio | `#7c3aed` | `--color-iris-studio` | Studio Mode badge icon and Studio Mode linked phrases (estimated from screenshot) — the second mode hue. Keep it confined to Studio contexts so the two hues stay meaningful. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Instrument Sans — the display and reading-UI grotesk, set quiet at weight 400 · `--font-instrument-sans`

- **Substitute:** Instrument Sans itself at 400 (free on Google Fonts); Inter Display at 400 with an extra −0.005em of tracking, since it draws slightly wider; Hanken Grotesk at 400, which matches the stroke closely.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 13px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 19px, 48px, 54px, 60px
- **Line height:** 0.98, 1.0, 1.375, 1.5, 1.55
- **Letter spacing:** −1.8px at 60px, −1.62px at 54px, −1.44px at 48px, −0.38px at 19px, −0.14px at 14px, normal at 15px and 16px
- **Role:** Weight 400 at 60px is the signature. Headlines are large and calm, and they refuse the 600–700 weight that conventional SaaS heroes default to. The display steps run 48 → 54 → 60, a ratio of about 1.11, which is tighter than a Minor Third 1.2. The headline tier therefore reads as one voice with three volumes rather than a ladder. A constant −0.03em tracking keeps the large sizes compact. Weight 500 appears only at 15px, for inline feature lead-ins. Nav links render in a system "defaultFont" at a similar measure and follow the same rules.

### Source Serif 4 — the light reading voice and the italic swerve in the H1 · `--font-source-serif-4`

- **Substitute:** Source Serif 4 itself at 300 (free on Google Fonts); Newsreader at 300, which draws slightly heavier and matches the rendered stroke; Literata at 300, the closest in x-height.
- **Weights:** 300, 400
- **Sizes:** 15.5px, 18px, 19px, 60px
- **Line height:** 1.33, 1.5, 1.55
- **Letter spacing:** −0.19px at 19px, −0.18px at 18px, −0.155px at 15.5px, −1.8px at 60px italic
- **Role:** A weight-300 serif under a grotesk headline is the anti-convention move. B2B screen-recorder sites normally run sans throughout, and this pairing makes every lead paragraph read like an editorial standfirst. The −0.01em tracking keeps the light strokes from spacing apart. The italic "for everyone." at 60px is the one place the serif takes display size, so it works as punctuation rather than decoration.

### Geist — the micro-label face for mockup chrome and metadata · `--font-geist`

- **Substitute:** Geist itself at 500 (free from Vercel); Inter at 500, which draws marginally lighter, so do not drop to 400; IBM Plex Sans at 500 for a more technical texture.
- **Weights:** 300, 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 10px, 10.5px, 11px, 11.5px, 12px, 12.5px, 13px, 13.5px, 14px, 16px, 21px
- **Line height:** 1.33, 1.5, 1.71
- **Letter spacing:** −0.42px at 21px, normal elsewhere
- **Role:** Geist at 500 is the workhorse by count, with 318 uses, nearly all inside product mockups at 10–14px. Medium weight at micro sizes keeps toolbars and timelines legible when the screenshots are scaled down. Its half-pixel steps (10.5, 11.5, 12.5, 13.5) show that the mockups are rebuilt in HTML, not pasted as bitmaps. DM Mono at 400–500 appears in 9 spots for timecodes and follows the same micro-label role.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Geist | 500 | 10.5px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Geist | 500 | 12px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Instrument Sans | 400 | 14px | 1.5 | -0.14px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Instrument Sans | 400 | 15px | 1.55 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Source Serif 4 | 300 | 19px | 1.5 | -0.19px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Geist | 500 | 21px | 1.5 | -0.42px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading | Instrument Sans | 400 | 48px | 1.0 | -1.44px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Instrument Sans | 400 | 54px | 1.0 | -1.62px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Instrument Sans | 400 | 60px | 0.98 | -1.8px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every H1 and H2 in Instrument Sans weight 400 with −0.03em tracking (−1.8px at 60px) — quiet weight at large size is the signature, and size alone carries rank.
- Put every lead paragraph under a headline in Source Serif 4 weight 300 at 19px, color #111111a3 — the serif standfirst turns product claims into prose.
- Draw container edges with `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(17,17,17,0.05)` before reaching for a border or drop shadow — rings keep panels flat on the #f2f2f2 fog.
- Restrict #2563eb to Instant Mode phrases, mode icons and active states, and #7c3aed to Studio contexts — each hue is a product mode, not a brand flourish.
- Use 9999px for every chip, switcher, badge and avatar, and 10px for both hero buttons — two shapes, one for selection and one for commitment.
- Center section headers inside a 760px column with 128px between sections — the generous rhythm lets dense mockups breathe.
- Build mockup chrome in Geist weight 500 at 10.5–12px — micro-labels at medium weight survive downscaling.

### Don't

- Do not bold the headlines to 600 or 700 — the system's authority comes from weight 400 at 54–60px, and heavier strokes turn the editorial voice into a stock SaaS banner.
- Do not set lead paragraphs in Instrument Sans to "simplify" the stack — dropping the weight-300 serif deletes the two-voice thesis that separates Cap from every sans-only competitor.
- Do not fill the primary CTA with solid #2563eb — the hero action is #e1effe glass with a blue ring, and a saturated slab outshouts the H1.
- Do not add a third accent hue for marketing sections — the color count is non-negotiable at two, one per recording mode.
- Do not swap the 1px rgba(17,17,17,0.05) rings for 0 8px 24px drop shadows on feature items — depth is reserved for the 28px demo stage only.
- Do not use #8a8f98 for multi-line body text — at 15px on #f2f2f2 it falls below comfortable contrast, so use #111111a3 or #6b7079.
- Do not set uppercase tracked eyebrows above section titles — the mode badge with its 20px colored disc already labels the section, and a 0.1em eyebrow duplicates it.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #f2f2f2 (Fog Canvas)
- elevated surface: #ffffff (Paper White)
- primary text: #111111 (Jet Ink)
- secondary text: #111111a3 (Ink Caption)
- hairline: #e1e7ee (Quartz Hairline)
- accent: #2563eb (Signal Cobalt)
- inverted surface: #1c1d21 (Onyx Ink)
- primary action: #e1effe (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Viewer-analytics charts use #8a8f98 at 40% opacity for every series except the one highlighted series, which may take solid #2563eb, so the accent marks one answer and the chart does not become the loudest element on the page.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: background #e1effe, text #111111 in Instrument Sans 16px weight 400 with 24px line-height, height 48px, padding 0 24px, border-radius 10px, no CSS border, and box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(63,127,205,0.65), inset 0 2px 3px -1px rgba(255,255,255,0.8), inset 0 -1px 1px 0 rgba(61,119,194,0.2), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(61,119,194,0.2), 0 10px 24px -10px rgba(120,178,240,0.55)`. Place a 16px platform icon 8px before the label. Pair it 12px to the left of a secondary button: background #ffffff, 1px solid #d3dce6 border, the same 10px radius, 48px height and 0 24px padding.

2. Build a hero section: a panel inset 32px from the viewport sides on a #f2f2f2 page, border-radius 28px, filled with a soft blue sky illustration. Center a 760px column with 24px gaps. Stack a #1c1d21 announcement pill at 9999px radius with 12px Geist weight 500 white text, then a #ffffff66 mode switcher at 9999px radius with 32px items in Instrument Sans 16px #11111180, the active item on #e1effe. Below that, place an H1 in Instrument Sans 60px weight 400, line-height 0.98, letter-spacing -1.8px, color #111111, ending in an italic Source Serif 4 phrase at the same size. Follow with a 560px Source Serif 4 weight 300 paragraph at 19px, line-height 1.5, letter-spacing -0.19px, color #111111a3, and then the button pair.

3. Build a feature grid: max-width 1120px, a 1px #e1e7ee top rule, 32px top padding, 3 columns with 24px column gaps and 32px row gaps. Each item has a 24px square #e1effe tile at 8px radius holding a 14px #2563eb line icon, followed after a 12px gap by one paragraph at 14px with line-height 1.5. The paragraph opens with a 15px Instrument Sans weight 500 #111111 lead-in sentence and continues in Instrument Sans 400 #6b7079. Do not add card backgrounds or shadows to the items.

4. Build a mode section header: centered, with a #ffffff badge at 9999px radius, padding 4px 12px 4px 4px, shadow `0 0 0 1px rgba(17,17,17,0.06), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(17,17,17,0.03)`, a 20px #2563eb icon disc and the 14px Instrument Sans weight 500 label "Instant Mode". Leave 24px, then an H2 at 54px weight 400, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing -1.62px, #111111, max-width 760px. Leave 16px, then a Source Serif 4 weight 300 paragraph at 19px, #111111a3, max-width 600px, with key phrases linked in #2563eb weight 400. Leave 56px before a 28px-radius #ffffff Demo Stage Card using the `--shadow-md` stack and 24px padding.

Background #e1effe, text #111111, no CSS border because the edge comes from the `--shadow-lg` stack (a 1px inset rgba(63,127,205,0.65) ring, a white top highlight and a soft blue under-glow), border-radius 10px, padding 0 24px, height 48px, Instrument Sans 16px weight 400 with a leading platform glyph — the accent arrives as tinted glass and light rather than a solid #2563eb slab, which keeps the hero CTA unmistakable without shouting.

### Outline Button — Paper (Secondary)

**Role:** Explanatory or scroll-to secondary action

The quiet sibling. Background #ffffff, text #111111, border 1px solid #d3dce6, border-radius 10px, padding 0 24px, height 48px, Instrument Sans 16px weight 400, no shadow, with a trailing 16px circular arrow chip in #ffffff66 — it shares height and radius with the primary, so the pair reads as one unit separated only by tint.

### Sign Up Button — Onyx (Nav)

**Role:** Account creation in the nav

The single solid fill. Background #1c1d21, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 8px, padding 8px 12px, height 40px, nav face at 15px weight 500, with the `--shadow-subtle-2` bevel (a 0.35 white top highlight and a 0.12 black bottom inset) — the only dark button on the page, so the account action outranks everything in the header.

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Absolute-positioned transparent top bar

Floating, unfilled, 76px tall. No background, so it sits directly on the #f2f2f2 canvas above the hero panel. A 90×40px logo on the left is followed by text links (Product, Download, Agents, Testimonials, Help, About, Blog, Pricing) at 15px weight 500 in #111111d9 (an alpha of Jet Ink), each with padding 8px 12px, height 40px and a 6px hover radius. The right side holds GitHub (24.5k), an outlined #ffffff Login with a 1px #d3dce6 border at 8px radius, and Sign Up — it scrolls away rather than sticking, deliberately yielding the viewport to the product.

### Announcement Pill — Onyx

**Role:** Release notice above the hero

An inverted capsule. Background #1c1d21, text #ffffff at 12px Geist weight 500, an inner "New" tag in #e1effe with #2563eb text, then "Read the deep dive" in Slate Caption #8a8f98, border-radius 9999px, padding 4px 6px 4px 4px, height 28px, `--shadow-sm-2` — the system outlier that puts onyx above the headline, allowed because news must outrank the mode switcher for one glance.

### Mode Switcher — Frosted Segmented Pills

**Role:** Instant / Studio / Screenshot selector

Glass tabs on sky. The track is #ffffff66 with border-radius 9999px and padding 4px. Items are 32px tall with padding 0 12px, Instrument Sans 16px weight 400 in #11111180 (an alpha of Jet Ink), with 14px icons. The active item takes #e1effe fill and #111111 text at the same 9999px radius. The same pattern repeats as the Record / Stop and paste / Watch strip under demo stages — the canonical way to switch content without leaving the page.

### Mode Badge — Cobalt or Iris

**Role:** Section eyebrow naming the mode

The eyebrow replacement. Background #ffffff, text #111111 at 14px Instrument Sans weight 500, a 20px circular icon disc in #2563eb (Instant) or #7c3aed (Studio), border-radius 9999px, padding 4px 12px 4px 4px, `--shadow-sm` ring — it swaps the conventional uppercase micro-eyebrow for a product chip and color-codes the section that follows.

### Demo Stage Card

**Role:** Main content card framing product mockups

The primary container. Background #ffffff fading upward into a #e1effe wash, no CSS border, border-radius 28px, padding 24px around the mockup, `--shadow-md` (a 0.06 ring plus a 30px/60px/−40px drop), with a centered segmented tab strip inside at the bottom — this is the one place real depth is allowed, because it holds the product.

### Feature Item — Icon Tile with Inline Lead-in

**Role:** Three-column capability list entry

Text-first, no card. A 24px icon tile in #e1effe at 6px radius holding a #2563eb line icon, then a 12px gap, then one paragraph at body-sm 14px. The lead-in is a 15px Instrument Sans weight 500 heading in #111111 and the remainder runs on in #6b7079. Items sit in a 3-column grid with 24px row gaps under a 1px #e1e7ee rule — the inline bold-then-plain sentence reads like a spec sheet written by an editor.

### Hero Sky Panel

**Role:** Full-bleed illustrated hero container

An inset rounded stage. Painted sky gradient with soft clouds (decorative imagery, not a system token), inset 32px from the viewport edges, border-radius 28px, a centered column of 760px max-width holding the announcement pill, mode switcher, 60px display H1, 19px serif lead and button pair, then a MacBook mockup cropped at the panel's bottom edge — the sky carries the brand mood so no other section needs color.

### Floating Chat Button

**Role:** Persistent support launcher

A dark circle. Background #1c1d21 with a #ffffff speech-bubble glyph, border-radius 9999px, 40px diameter, fixed 32px from the right edge, `--shadow-sm-2` — the only fixed element, given onyx so it registers once and then recedes.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every H1 and H2 in Instrument Sans weight 400 with −0.03em tracking (−1.8px at 60px) — quiet weight at large size is the signature, and size alone carries rank.
- Put every lead paragraph under a headline in Source Serif 4 weight 300 at 19px, color #111111a3 — the serif standfirst turns product claims into prose.
- Draw container edges with `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(17,17,17,0.05)` before reaching for a border or drop shadow — rings keep panels flat on the #f2f2f2 fog.
- Restrict #2563eb to Instant Mode phrases, mode icons and active states, and #7c3aed to Studio contexts — each hue is a product mode, not a brand flourish.
- Use 9999px for every chip, switcher, badge and avatar, and 10px for both hero buttons — two shapes, one for selection and one for commitment.
- Center section headers inside a 760px column with 128px between sections — the generous rhythm lets dense mockups breathe.
- Build mockup chrome in Geist weight 500 at 10.5–12px — micro-labels at medium weight survive downscaling.

### Don't

- Do not bold the headlines to 600 or 700 — the system's authority comes from weight 400 at 54–60px, and heavier strokes turn the editorial voice into a stock SaaS banner.
- Do not set lead paragraphs in Instrument Sans to "simplify" the stack — dropping the weight-300 serif deletes the two-voice thesis that separates Cap from every sans-only competitor.
- Do not fill the primary CTA with solid #2563eb — the hero action is #e1effe glass with a blue ring, and a saturated slab outshouts the H1.
- Do not add a third accent hue for marketing sections — the color count is non-negotiable at two, one per recording mode.
- Do not swap the 1px rgba(17,17,17,0.05) rings for 0 8px 24px drop shadows on feature items — depth is reserved for the 28px demo stage only.
- Do not use #8a8f98 for multi-line body text — at 15px on #f2f2f2 it falls below comfortable contrast, so use #111111a3 or #6b7079.
- Do not set uppercase tracked eyebrows above section titles — the mode badge with its 20px colored disc already labels the section, and a 0.1em eyebrow duplicates it.

## Imagery

Imagery is almost entirely product: full-fidelity macOS mockups rebuilt in HTML, including the Cap editor, a Ledgerly invoice app, timelines, a dock and a webcam bubble at 9999px radius. Each sits inside a 28px Demo Stage Card or a MacBook bezel, and the screens are inset at 16px radius. Painted landscapes (a Bay Area street, a Brooklyn waterfront) appear only as wallpaper inside the mockups and are mockup-internal. The hero's cloud-filled sky is decorative illustration, not a system token, and it is the page's only large color field. Icons are 14–16px single-weight line glyphs in #2563eb on #e1effe tiles. There are no glows or orbs beyond the blue under-glow of the primary button. The narrative is that the product is the hero, demonstrated live rather than described.

## Layout

Content caps at 1120px, and centered text blocks narrow to 760px for headlines and 560–600px for serif leads. The 76px nav is absolutely positioned and transparent: logo and links sit on the left, and GitHub, Login and Sign Up sit on the right. Below it, the hero is an inset 28px-radius sky panel with a centered single column. It stacks announcement pill, mode switcher, H1, serif lead, a two-button row, then a cropped laptop mockup and a progress tab strip. Each following mode section repeats a fixed cadence of mode badge, H2, serif paragraph, Demo Stage Card and a caption, then a 3-column feature grid under a hairline rule. Sections are separated by 128px. The 750px footer sits under a 1px top hairline. At 375px, drop the display to the 48px heading step, use 64px section gaps and collapse grids to one column. Overall density: comfortable.

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #f2f2f2 (Fog Canvas)
- elevated surface: #ffffff (Paper White)
- primary text: #111111 (Jet Ink)
- secondary text: #111111a3 (Ink Caption)
- hairline: #e1e7ee (Quartz Hairline)

**Color in Data**

Viewer-analytics charts use #8a8f98 at 40% opacity for every series except the one highlighted series, which may take solid #2563eb, so the accent marks one answer and the chart does not become the loudest element on the page.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: background #e1effe, text #111111 in Instrument Sans 16px weight 400 with 24px line-height, height 48px, padding 0 24px, border-radius 10px, no CSS border, and box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(63,127,205,0.65), inset 0 2px 3px -1px rgba(255,255,255,0.8), inset 0 -1px 1px 0 rgba(61,119,194,0.2), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(61,119,194,0.2), 0 10px 24px -10px rgba(120,178,240,0.55)`. Place a 16px platform icon 8px before the label. Pair it 12px to the left of a secondary button: background #ffffff, 1px solid #d3dce6 border, the same 10px radius, 48px height and 0 24px padding.

2. Build a hero section: a panel inset 32px from the viewport sides on a #f2f2f2 page, border-radius 28px, filled with a soft blue sky illustration. Center a 760px column with 24px gaps. Stack a #1c1d21 announcement pill at 9999px radius with 12px Geist weight 500 white text, then a #ffffff66 mode switcher at 9999px radius with 32px items in Instrument Sans 16px #11111180, the active item on #e1effe. Below that, place an H1 in Instrument Sans 60px weight 400, line-height 0.98, letter-spacing -1.8px, color #111111, ending in an italic Source Serif 4 phrase at the same size. Follow with a 560px Source Serif 4 weight 300 paragraph at 19px, line-height 1.5, letter-spacing -0.19px, color #111111a3, and then the button pair.

3. Build a feature grid: max-width 1120px, a 1px #e1e7ee top rule, 32px top padding, 3 columns with 24px column gaps and 32px row gaps. Each item has a 24px square #e1effe tile at 8px radius holding a 14px #2563eb line icon, followed after a 12px gap by one paragraph at 14px with line-height 1.5. The paragraph opens with a 15px Instrument Sans weight 500 #111111 lead-in sentence and continues in Instrument Sans 400 #6b7079. Do not add card backgrounds or shadows to the items.

4. Build a mode section header: centered, with a #ffffff badge at 9999px radius, padding 4px 12px 4px 4px, shadow `0 0 0 1px rgba(17,17,17,0.06), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(17,17,17,0.03)`, a 20px #2563eb icon disc and the 14px Instrument Sans weight 500 label "Instant Mode". Leave 24px, then an H2 at 54px weight 400, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing -1.62px, #111111, max-width 760px. Leave 16px, then a Source Serif 4 weight 300 paragraph at 19px, #111111a3, max-width 600px, with key phrases linked in #2563eb weight 400. Leave 56px before a 28px-radius #ffffff Demo Stage Card using the `--shadow-md` stack and 24px padding.

## Two-Voice Typography

The core discipline is that a grotesk speaks and a serif explains. Instrument Sans at weight 400 owns every headline from 48 to 60px. Source Serif 4 at weight 300 owns every paragraph that directly follows a headline. The 60px italic serif phrase in the H1 is the single crossover. Raising headline weight to 600 breaks it, and so does setting a lead paragraph in sans or scattering serif italics across H2s. Each of these collapses the contrast that makes the page read as prose. To extend the system, put any new explanatory sentence under a headline in the serif at 19px. Put anything operational (labels, buttons, feature lead-ins) in sans at 14–16px. Allow at most one italic serif phrase per page.

## Mode-Coded Color

Color here encodes information. #2563eb means Instant Mode, sharing and live links, and #7c3aed means Studio Mode and editing. Both appear only in linked phrases, 20px badge discs, active pills and icon tiles. The neutral fog-and-paper stack carries everything else. Three things break the system: a cobalt section background, a gradient headline, or a new hue for a pricing highlight. Each detaches color from product meaning, after which the badges stop working as wayfinding. To extend the system, give a new recording mode its own hue and use it only in the same four slots. For marketing emphasis, use the pale #e1effe tint or size, not saturation.

## Rings Before Shadows

Depth is rationed. The default edge is a 1px rgba(17,17,17,0.05) inset ring, which appears 33 times. The full 30px/60px/−40px drop is reserved for Demo Stage Cards that hold the product. A conventional card-everything approach with 8px drop shadows on feature items would flatten that ranking, and the mockups would stop reading as the most important object on the page. To extend the system, start every new container as a #ffffff panel with the inset ring on #f2f2f2. Promote it to `--shadow-md` only when it frames live product UI.

## Similar Brands

- **Cap** — Loom: the same record-and-share category and centered hero-plus-product layout, but Cap swaps Loom's saturated purple fills for a two-hue mode code and a serif lead.
- **Cap** — Screen Studio: product-as-hero macOS mockups with painted wallpapers inside the frame, though Cap rebuilds them as interactive HTML demos.
- **Cap** — Linear: 1px low-alpha ring shadows instead of borders and weight-400 display headlines with tight negative tracking.
- **Cap** — Raycast: high-fidelity macOS window chrome with traffic-light dots and medium-weight micro-labels as the main imagery.
- **Cap** — Vercel: Geist at weight 500 for small UI text and a near-monochrome #111111-on-light palette, with Cap adding a serif reading voice Vercel does not use.
